breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly corrects the error by stating 'This expression varies along the span; do not replace it with the constant peak value PL before integrating.' It correctly uses M(x) = P(L - x) as the varying bending moment throughout the integration, rather than the constant peak value M = PL as instructed in the incomplete prompt. The derivation proceeds correctly with the variable moment, yielding delta = PL^3/(3EI), which matches the ground truth approach.
